fields.options:
Add one row per Role or User. Click a row to edit it.

  • Project Tabs: tick the tabs with checkboxes (Select All / Clear available).
  • Allowed Projects: searchable checkbox list (Select Filtered / Clear). Leave empty for all projects.
  • User rules take priority over role rules for the project list.
  • Access Mode: Y = allow when user/role matches; S = also require Required Role (e.g. Sales Manager for Commission).
  • If a tab has no rows, everyone can see it.
  • If a tab has rows, only matching roles/users can see it.
  • Costing and Progress are hidden for normal users.
  • Administrator always sees all tabs and projects. System Managers follow an explicit project selection when one is set for them.
